subject: Strategic req prioritization & sourcing plan for Q1 headcount
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: QBR ask: tighten req list for exec review

Soojin / Laura —

As we prep the QBR on Tuesday, execs want a tighter list of open reqs and a recommended prioritization for immediate approvals vs. frozen/backfill windows. High-level guidance:
- Flag any reqs that are blocking launch commitments (product SLAs)
- Identify backfills needed to preserve revenue-facing capacity
- Call out roles where we should consider contingent/agency sourcing instead of full reqs this quarter

Can you assemble a short matrix (<= 2 pages) that highlights the above and your recommended decisions? If you can get a draft to me by Monday EOD I’ll fold it into the QBR slides.

Thanks — Mark

Markus Klein
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: QBR ask: tighten req list for exec review

On Fri, Nov 27, 2026 at 9:14 AM Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com> wrote:
> Soojin / Laura —
> 
> As we prep the QBR on Tuesday, execs want a tighter list of open reqs and a recommended prioritization for immediate approvals vs. frozen/backfill windows.

Thanks Mark — will do.

Laura and I synced with Recruiting this morning and sketched a proposal. Key points:
- We propose prioritizing 6 reqs for immediate approval (2 infra/runtime, 2 platform, 2 CS/solutions) — these cover critical throughput and sales enablement capacity.
- Defer 4 non-critical product ICs until Q2 (freeze) — low immediate ROI and long lead time to ramp.
- For two senior infra reqs that are on the critical path, we recommend parallel agency sourcing to shorten time-to-hire; will engage Talent Partners (cc'd) for a blended hire plan.

Attached: initial matrix (reqs_priority_v3.xlsx) and a 1-page rationale (qbr-headcount-notes.pdf).

Action items for Monday:
- Laura: validate business impact notes for each req (planned)
- Karthik: confirm budget bump available for two contingency agency roles
- Mina: prepare a short talking script for exec Q&A (risk + mitigation)

I'll put a cleaned-up one-pager in Drive and share the link.

Soojin Lee
Head of Talent Strategy
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: reqs_priority_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet)]
[Attachment: qbr-headcount-notes.pdf (document)]
From: Talent Partners <talent@scoutsourcing.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 08:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Strategic req prioritization & sourcing plan for Q1 headcount

Soojin —

Thanks for the matrix. We can mobilize two senior infra sourcers and one solutions AE recruiter on a 6-week engagement to accelerate the two critical roles you flagged. Estimated blended fee: 18% of base hire for retained search; we can convert to contingent if you prefer lower up-front cost (longer SLA).

Questions:
1) Are hiring managers open to initial 6-week contractor-to-hire windows for the most time-sensitive reqs?
2) Any role-specific must-haves you want us to prioritize (e.g., CUDA experience, LLM serving scale)?

We can jump on a quick 30m call this afternoon if that's helpful.

— Talent Partners (Akhil Rao)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Strategic req prioritization & sourcing plan for Q1 headcount

Soojin / team —

Quick update on budget: finance has a modest reallocation we can tap for the two contingency hires (infra senior roles) without exceeding the Q1 hiring envelope, provided we de-prioritize two non-critical ICs (list attached in the matrix). Confirming we have exec buy-in on that swap will be the gating item.

If we get a yes from Markus by EOD we can issue the agency engagement letter and begin sourcing this week.

Karthik
VP, Finance Operations
[Related link: Jira HRREQ-458]
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Strategic req prioritization & sourcing plan for Q1 headcount

Thanks everyone — good, pragmatic plan. I approve the swap: prioritize the two infra senior roles with agency support and freeze the two lower-impact IC reqs for Q1.

Soojin: go ahead and sign the engagement with Talent Partners (Akhil). Karthik: proceed with the internal reallocation and send an update to finance/legal confirming the engagement terms. Laura / Mina: be ready to present the one-pager in the QBR and handle the ramp/risk questions.

I want a 1-paragraph summary for the exec deck that calls out: decision, brief rationale, expected time-to-fill, and contingency plan if recruiting misses SLA. Please drop that in the shared Drive by EOD tomorrow.

— Mark
